backgrounds: signal only plus independent Gaussian native-pixel noise
rules.candidate: plane_fixed target padding, fixed original neighbour templates
rules.covariance: candidate GN and observed profile Hessian with original registration covariance; no conditional calibration
rules.selection: all attempts and common numeric/common accepted subsets, separately by field and case
rules.qualification: opened fields and matched old truth only; diagnostic development, not independent validation or physical PSF proof

record_schema: error is east,north arcsec; point is before,after sky pixel; covariance and profile_covariance are displacement arcsec²; q is squared Mahalanobis; epoch_profile and baseline_epoch_profile elements are [supported, reason, relative_step_change] in before,after order

gaia.query: SELECT source_id, ref_epoch, ra, dec, parallax, pmra, pmdec, ra_error, dec_error, parallax_error, pmra_error, pmdec_error, ra_dec_corr, ra_parallax_corr, ra_pmra_corr, ra_pmdec_corr, dec_parallax_corr, dec_pmra_corr, dec_pmdec_corr, parallax_pmra_corr, parallax_pmdec_corr, pmra_pmdec_corr, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved, visibility_periods_used, duplicated_source, ipd_frac_multi_peak, non_single_star, phot_variable_flag FROM gaia_dr3_source WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',350.0,35.0,0.25))=1 AND phot_g_mean_mag<18.5 ORDER BY source_id

catwise.query: SELECT source_name,ra,dec,ra_pm,dec_pm,sigra_pm,sigdec_pm,pmra,pmdec,sigpmra,sigpmdec,meanobsmjd,w1mpro_pm,w2mpro_pm,w2snr_pm,w2rchi2_pm,cc_flags,ab_flags FROM catwise_2020 WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',350.0,35.0,0.30))=1 AND w2mpro_pm<17 AND w2snr_pm>=5 ORDER BY source_name
